title: Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 2018
ACT XXI OF 2018
SINDH WORKERS WELFARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th May, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-18/2018,
dated 17.5.2018.---The Sindh
Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th April, 2018 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act No. XXXIII of 2015

ACT XXI OF 2018
ACT XXI OF 2018
SINDH WORKERS WELFARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th May, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-18/2018,
dated 17.5.2018.---The Sindh
Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th April, 2018 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 3 of Sindh Act No. XXXIII of 2015.---In the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014, hereinafter referred to
as the said Act, in section 3, in subsection (2)-
(a) for
clause (ii), the following shall be substituted-
"(ii)
the Chairman, Standing Committee on Labour and Human Resources in the Provincial
Assembly, ex-officio";
(b) in
clauses (iv) and (v), for the word "three", the word "four"
shall be substituted;
(c) in
clause (vi), for the word "Health", the word "Finance"
shall be substituted; and
(d) clauses
(vii), (viii) and (ix) shall be omitted.
